# Executive Workforce Plan — 2027

The confidential workforce plan authorizes up to 12 net new positions during 2027. The planning
allocation is five Engineering roles, three Sales roles, two Customer Support roles, one Finance
role, and one People role.

Hiring proceeds in two stages. Stage one permits six positions after the annual budget is
approved. Stage two may begin only when first-half recurring revenue reaches 95% of plan and the
executive team confirms that operating expenses remain within budget.

Department leaders may know only their approved openings. Company-wide allocation, hiring gates,
and contingency scenarios remain executive-only until People publishes the approved headcount
plan. Changes to the allocation require CEO and Finance approval.
